body.title: Runner: acted tracking, classification, logging
body.summary: In chat-panel.ts the queued-turn runner tracks acted: set when the queued turn emits a tool-call, file-edit or tool-result event and never cleared, including across an approval re-run. settleQueued resolves a failed turn as {kind:'failed', error, acted, cause: classifyFailure(error)} and logs every failed turn's cause and error text through the chat logger. The 'the chat no longer exists' failure stays acted:false with no cause.
acceptanceChecks: a turn that emitted a tool-call, file-edit or tool-result before its error reports acted true
a turn that failed with none of them reports acted false and the classified cause
acted stays true across an approval re-run of the same queued message
every failed turn's cause and error text are logged
the 'chat no longer exists' failure has acted false and no cause

tests.name: chat-queue-runner.test.ts: a turn that emitted a tool-call, file-edit or tool-result before its error reports acted true; one that failed with none reports acted false with the classified cause
chat-queue-runner.test.ts: a claude is_error result with an overload text before any tool call is reported failed with the overload cause; the same after a file edit reports acted true
chat-queue-runner.test.ts: every failed turn's cause and error text are logged
